supplemental.body:
## Why

Refs MIN-614. Global encryption exposed additional loading costs in the desktop app. This first measured delivery reduces repeated encrypted PR reads and fixes native renderer style invalidation. MIN-614 remains open for the outstanding acceptance work recorded in its plan.

## Changes

- Coalesce repository identity decoding within each authorized operation, verify immutable index tokens without a writer-key lookup, and parallelize independent PR/count/sync/agent-decoration reads. Preserve source ordering, permission filters, GCM binding, key rotation and provider separation. No plaintext cache persists across requests.
- Replace two root `:has(.app-top-bar)` CSS selectors with a marker owned by the mounted application bar. Preserve native drag/no-drag regions and responsive behavior.
- Move activity-text overflow measurement after layout while preserving its DOM/focus; skip unnecessary board geometry reads when its scroll offset is already restored.
- Add reproducible native/repository benchmarks, aggregate-only before/after evidence, a PostHog error investigation and synthetic light-mode screenshots. No migrations, new dependencies, API contract changes or breaking changes.

## Verification

- 44 focused tests across ten files; supplementary provider/upsert regression coverage.
- Production build, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check:owned-english`, `npm run check:encrypted-access`, `npm run check:encryption-schema`, and `git diff --check` pass. Every commit has a matching DCO sign-off.
- Actual unpackaged Electron 43.7.5, fresh temporary profiles, the existing encrypted 600-issue fixture, and local production servers. No plaintext seeding, profile copying or fabricated forge responses.

| Measurement | Baseline | Candidate | Candidate repeat |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native issue dialog median | 1,210 ms | 316 ms | 328 ms |
| Native board return median | 1,430 ms | 1,151 ms | 1,108 ms |
| Native PR list route median | 1,400 ms | 739 ms | 3,709 ms |
| Native PR list navigation, one observation | 2,722 ms | 1,821 ms | 2,280 ms |

The native issue style-time median drops from 785 to 138 ms, reproduced at 133 ms. A 51-PR authorized repository read drops from 111 to 11 upstream calls and from 749 to 455 ms in the three warm samples. Native readiness samples are small and are not field INP or p95 estimates. The slower PR repeat and a 48-second successful writer-key-read outlier are retained; no universal end-to-end PR latency improvement is claimed.

Full methodology, observations, PostHog links and follow-ups: [MIN-614 audit](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614.md).

## Risks and dependencies

The board still stalls on activation with 600 rich cards. Loaded feedback, active agent streams, packaged-app behavior and connected-forge detail/diff navigation need further measurements. The fixture has no forge credentials; PR screenshots show stored list readiness and a pending/unavailable detail, not successful forge content. PostHog identity/key/schema errors and Supabase transport latency remain unresolved. This PR must not close MIN-614 or trigger a deployment.

Encryption, RLS, current-writer-key checks and root-key/cache policy remain unchanged. The native titlebar marker changes styling only while the application bar exists; StrictMode cleanup and drag-band policy are covered. Added screenshots contain the repository's synthetic performance fixture only, with no customer content or secrets. No external asset/dependency licensing changes.

## Screenshots

Native issue opening, light-mode synthetic fixture:

![Native issue dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf/docs/audits/assets/min-614-issue-light.png)

Stored PR list; the fixture has no connected forge credentials:

![Stored PR list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pr-light.png)

## Checklist

- [x] Scope and measured outcome are associated with MIN-614; unfinished acceptance criteria remain explicit.
- [x] Every commit carries its author's DCO sign-off.
- [x] Regression coverage preserves the changed behavior and encryption guarantees.
- [x] Documentation is updated; locale catalogs require no changes.
- [x] No keys, customer data, private configuration or vulnerability details are included.
- [x] Added resources have documented synthetic origin; no new dependencies.

## Cumulative delivery: pass 2 and subsequent passes

At the user's request, this PR now contains both completed MIN-614 passes and will receive subsequent passes on the same branch, `codex/min-614-encryption-performance`. The original first-pass and pass-2 commits were preserved by fast-forward. PR #343 is superseded; there is no separate dependency to merge. The first-pass results above remain historical evidence; the following measurements use their own baseline and active-view readiness checks.

### Pass 2: retained boards and tab activation

Move public Next router subscriptions from each card to its column and pass the same navigation callback into card content and menu actions. This avoids 1,800 card router subscriptions replaying on the 600-card global board. Preserve React Activity, retained-view limits, live subscriptions, scroll/focus/filters/selection, optimistic drag-and-drop and authorized encrypted reads.

Three fresh native production Electron launches per implementation, with ten warm returns per variant per launch (30 samples per row):

| Scenario | Median readiness before → after | Reduction |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Close issue → global board | 201 → 198 ms | Essentially unchanged |
| Page → global board | 1,217 → 682 ms | 44% |
| Global → project board | 529 → 399 ms | 25% |
| Project → global board | 972 → 701 ms | 28% |
| Scrolled return | 1,371 → 786 ms | 43% |
| Filtered return | 1,066 → 544 ms | 49% |
| Hidden update → fresh board | 897 → 650 ms | 28% |

The runner requires the selected target tab, a visible non-inert active board, the expected card count and current title after hidden updates, no blocking dialog and two frames. A real Filters-menu click separately measures interaction response. Page-return input falls 217 → 152 ms; hidden-update input rises 224 → 238 ms. Several-hundred-millisecond stalls and cold-start variability remain. Heavy profiles are separate from ordinary samples. Rejected containment, permanently active Activity and catalog experiments are not shipped.

Measured source: baseline `66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf`; candidate `e08051839177e66b69b251c2cc871884367b091c`. [Pass-2 audit](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/7099e970d4c009b8591cfd7d10112a28f882068d/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-2.md) and [all samples, requests and errors](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/7099e970d4c009b8591cfd7d10112a28f882068d/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-2-results.json) retain runtime, build, dataset, reproduction commands, attribution and limitations.

Pass-2 validation: 136 focused tests in 19 files; production build, types, lint, owned-English, encrypted-access/schema checks and diff checks passed. Supplemental browser checks cover retained state, focus, shortcuts, drag persistence/reversal, eviction and tab closure. First-pass style and repository call-count gains were reverified. This consolidation only changes documentation; owned-English and diff checks pass again, and all four commits have matching DCO sign-offs.

PostHog key/identity/schema errors were inspected; sampled events lack route/release/session dimensions needed to establish a board-version cause. Connected forge, populated feedback/agent sessions, broader issue/Page workflows and packaged-release coverage remain open. The cumulative coverage matrix and next issue-details/activity/comments/relations/mutations pass are recorded in MIN-614.
